Waiting Period and Exclusions

Waiting Period:

- 30 days after the effective date of the rider or the date it is revived for any other causes,
- 120 days after the effective date of the rider for Specified Illnesses,
- 180 days after the effective date of the rider or the date it is revived for Mental Care Treatment (if applicable),

Exclusions:

Medical benefits are not payable as a consequence of:

(a) Pre-existing conditions.
(b) Specified illnesses during the first 120 days from the effective date of the rider.
(c) Any medical or physical conditions arising within 30 days of waiting period, except for accidental injuries.

Note: This is not a full list. Please refer to the certificate document for the exclusions under this certificate.
